description: Needs student-ok (confirm:true OR elicitation) after the student asked to read their ADAM mail, because senders and subjects are personal correspondence. Lists the first page of the ADAM inbox: mailId, date, read/unread status, has-attachments flag, sender display name (emails redacted) and subject — never bodies. Listing does not mark anything read. Does not send, reply, move, delete or mark mail. Follow nextCursor. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"confirm":true}.

confirm.description: Optional gate. Set true only after the student asked to read their ADAM mail. Mail is personal correspondence and untrusted. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"confirm":true}.

cursor.description: Opaque decimal token — copy nextCursor verbatim into cursor, do not invent offsets. Expired browser cursors require restarting the listing without cursor.

refresh.description: Re-read the inbox from ADAM; omit cursor when true

name: adam_list_mail

sender.description: Display name; email addresses are redacted

title: List ADAM mail (inbox headers)
